items.q: So I had written one cue for O.C. Smith

ctx.x: And they had a big, large screen. So I had written one cue for O.C. Smith, another one for Freddie Hubbard, another one for Marshall Royal, and somebody else, I forgot. So I just had chord symbols for Freddie Hubbard, you know?
